page.content:
Long-serving YouTube CEO after the Google era matured.

How Susan Wojcicki connects

  • Topic: YouTube — Susan Wojcicki was YouTube's CEO through the mature Partner era.
  • Faction: Google — Wojcicki was a longtime Google executive before and during her YouTube years.

What is Susan Wojcicki?

Susan Wojcicki, an early Google executive, ran YouTube from 2014 to 2023 as Partner Program rules, the algorithm, and creator celebrity became the public story.

Key threads lead to YouTube and Google.
